Class GameController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am56.view.TUI.controllers.BaseTUIController
it.polimi.ingsw.am56.view.TUI.controllers.GameController
All Implemented Interfaces:
UpdateHandler, MessageVisitor
public class GameController extends BaseTUIController
In-game TUI screen. It keeps a local copy of the game state (board, per-player stats, totems, current player, phase, era and round) that it updates from the server-push messages it visits, and renders it to the terminal. It also reads the local player's moves and sends the corresponding requests.

Concurrency is split across two daemon threads guarded by two monitors. The render thread waits on renderLock and, when state is marked dirty, coalesces the burst of messages from a single server "transaction" into one redraw (debounced by RENDER_DEBOUNCE_MS). The input thread waits on lock until it is the local player's turn in an actionable phase, prompts for the move, sends it and then waits for the state version to advance before prompting again. Incoming messages mutate the local state under lock, bump the state version, wake both threads and mark the screen dirty.

As a side effect of rendering, it derives a short player-facing event log by diffing successive stats/totem snapshots (e.g. "X picked Builder #12", "RED placed totem on tile A").
